Proportion Test Decision Tool

One- and Two-Proportion Tests for Binary Outcomes

Important classroom notes

Proportion tests are for binary outcomes, such as yes/no, success/failure, purchased/not purchased, or pass/fail.

Z-tests: the normal approximation should be adequate. The tool checks expected counts and warns when they are too small.

Exact Binomial: use when one population proportion is being tested and the normal approximation is not appropriate. The number of successes must be an integer.

Two-proportion exact test: this option is currently marked Coming Soon. Fisher's Exact Test will be added later.

Interpretation: a small p-value provides evidence against H₀; it does not by itself establish practical or causal significance.

Classroom statistical tool. Calculations are performed entirely in the browser using the standard normal and binomial distributions.
